# Master Server List

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-readme.sh. Edit servers.json for catalogue data or the generator for this introduction. -->

Official and community master servers for multiplayer games, including replacements for discontinued services.

**[Browse live status and server counts](https://ismygameserver.online/masters)**

## Status

Masters are checked daily. This README is a snapshot, updated when a status changes; counts may be older than the latest check.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| ✅ Online | Passed its configured check; TCP-only checks do not verify game lists |
| ❔ DNS only | Hostname resolves; no protocol query is available yet |
| ⚠️ No response | Check failed, including connection or query errors |
| ❌ No DNS | Checking network could not resolve a usable address |

**Official** means run by the developer, publisher or game's own project; **Community** means independently run. Retired masters are no longer checked and can be removed from configs. Retirement dates are sourced shutdown dates or the first failed check, as labelled.

<details>
<summary>Data and checker details</summary>

- [Catalogue](https://dgibbs64.github.io/Master-Server-List/servers.json): hosts, protocols and check results.
- [Server addresses](https://dgibbs64.github.io/Master-Server-List/servers-list.json): merged per game with duplicates removed, where supported.
- [History](https://dgibbs64.github.io/Master-Server-List/history.json): 180 days of results, stored on the `history` branch.

Each IPv4 address has its own queue, and up to 16 addresses are checked at once. Queries to one address are at least 10 seconds apart. Failures get two later retries, delayed at least 30 and 60 seconds. Refused TCP endpoints are checked once per pass. Override timing with `MASTER_MIN_INTERVAL` and `MASTER_RETRY_DELAY` (seconds) and parallelism with `MASTER_WORKERS`; `check_error` records failure reasons. Pacing does not guarantee a response or establish a provider's rate limit.

</details>

To contribute, edit `servers.json`, run `./scripts/generate-readme.sh` and open a pull request.

Status as of: 2026-10-25

## Halo: Combat Evolved

Bungie's patch 1.0.10 (May 2014) moved Halo PC and Custom Edition off GameSpy to this master: the server list comes from s1.master.hosthpc.com, servers report to s1.ms01.hosthpc.com, and NAT negotiation uses natneg1 and natneg2.hosthpc.com. The Chimera client mod uses the same hosts by default. Retail Halo lists under the GameSpy name halor; Custom Edition has its own entry.
